description: Search and filter the 5,000+ scored quant-finance papers. Returns compact records (scores, quadrant, topics, methods, authors, summary, paper_url, page_url) plus the total match count. Combine filters; use min_rigor 7 for credible empirical work; set has_code true for reproducible papers. Reported performance (sharpe, annual_return_pct, max_drawdown_pct, sample_start/end, transaction_costs, out_of_sample) is included when the paper discloses a backtest: filter with has_sharpe / min_sharpe and sort by sharpe or annual_return to answer 'how many papers disclose a Sharpe' or 'highest reported return' questions (use total for counts). Execution-realism flags (tcost_modeled, oos_method, data_resolution, evaluation_type) say whether trading results are net of costs and validated out of sample; empirical_rigor is capped at 6.0 when they are not (empirical_rigor_raw keeps the uncapped score). Follow up with get_paper for the abstract, score rationale and flowchart.

asset.description: Asset-class slug: equities, crypto, derivatives, fixed-income, commodities-energy, fx, credit, insurance, macro-multi-asset, esg-climate, private-markets, real-estate.

data_resolution.description: Finest market data used; one or more of: l2-book, tick, intraday-bars, daily, weekly-monthly, synthetic, none, unclear.

evaluation_type.description: Headline empirical result; one or more of: trading-pnl, execution-cost, forecast-accuracy, pricing-calibration, none.

has_backtest.description: Only papers that report (true) or do not report (false) a backtest of their own strategy on real market data.

has_code.description: Only papers with (true) or without (false) a public code link.

has_sharpe.description: Only papers that disclose (true) a Sharpe ratio for their own strategy.

max_drawdown.description: Reported maximum drawdown (%) at most this.

method.description: Method slug, e.g. deep-learning. See list_methods.

min_annual_return.description: Reported annualized return (%) at least this.

min_sharpe.description: Reported Sharpe ratio at least this.

oos_method.description: Out-of-sample validation; one or more of: holdout, walk-forward, cross-validation, none, unclear.

q.description: Free-text search over title, abstract, keywords and authors (terms are ANDed).

rigor_capped.description: Only papers whose Empirical Rigor was (true) or was not (false) capped at 6.0 for missing transaction costs or out-of-sample testing.

sort.description: Default: relevance when q is given, otherwise hub_score. sharpe / annual_return / drawdown sort by the paper's reported figures (papers without one last).

tcost_modeled.description: Transaction costs applied to the reported results; one or more (comma-separated) of: yes, partial, no, n/a, unclear.

topic.description: Topic-hub slug, e.g. market-microstructure. See list_topics.

name: search_papers
title: Search scored quant-finance papers
